regimes.class_balanced: same original data, equal probability classes
regimes.short_aug: 50% original class-balanced,50% paired augmented n48; positive-length distribution from original train restricted to1..8
regimes.length_balanced: same50/50 mixture and same augmented pool; uniform augmented positive length1..16

protocol.confounding: class_balanced to short_aug changes size, structure and negative-example difficulty; not a pure size effect

training.lr: original F4-bin LR per family, fixed across regimes and seeds
training.checkpoint: last at30000 primary; original validation monitoring every1000, no data-dependent extensions
training.sampling: fixed distribution from step1; no staged curriculum; virtual index reproducible from trainer batch RNG

pool.generator: mirrored chains with incoming trees and two-step detours; optional mirrored backward edges
pool.ER_augmentation_is_not_ER: controlled cyclic graph family distinct from original ER distribution
pool.negative_controls: same graph/weak component; matched source degrees; no directed path
pool.split_disjointness: reject exact labeled adjacency duplicates; no isomorphism-disjointness claim

test_plan.closed: freeze all40 final checkpoints before new test predictions
test_plan.extra_compute: fixed learned tensors; binomial coefficients recomputed for each r
test_plan.primary: BA at logit0, paired-seed differences; all5seeds retained
test_plan.calibration: separate thresholds from original validation and augmented validation n48 length1..16; no test calibration
test_plan.inference_source: separately frozen after queue launch but before new test predictions

resources.includes: GPU checks, profiling, training and inference; actual Slurm allocation accounting
